sources.title: Republic of Korea MOFA Overseas Safety: North Macedonia entry information
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Republic of Korea
sources.officialityEvidence: Korea MOFA's current Overseas Safety destination page explicitly separates diplomatic, official and ordinary Republic of Korea passport entry treatment.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Ordinary multi- and single-passport holders: visa-free, 90 days in 180; no visa on arrival.

sources.title: Visas to Jordan
sources.officialityEvidence: The page identifies itself as the official Jordan Tourism Board site and its current nationality table gives South Korea's visitor-arrival procedure.
sources.supportingExcerpt: South Korea: Applicable — Visa can be obtained upon arrival, total cost 40 JOD.

policies.title: Republic of Korea ordinary passports: North Macedonia visa-free short visit
policies.summary: Korea MOFA's current North Macedonia entry guidance states that both ordinary single and multiple Republic of Korea passports are visa-free for 90 days in 180 days.
conditions: The stated maximum stay is 90 days in any 180-day period for either an ordinary single or multiple passport.
This is limited to the ordinary short-visitor baseline; work, residence, special documents and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Republic of Korea ordinary passports: Jordan arrival visa
policies.summary: Jordan's official Tourism Board nationality table states that a South Korean visitor visa can be obtained on arrival for 40 JOD.
conditions: The published ordinary visitor arrival-visa fee is 40 JOD.
This excludes work, residence, special documents, crossing-specific restrictions and final admission.
